items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: Claude Rabani and me, the cornets. Mowgli, Jospin, and the trombone.

ctx.x: The name of the people, yes. And the instrument. Yes. Claude Luther, clarinet. Claude Rabani and me, the cornets. Mowgli, Jospin, and the trombone. He was, before he was in the trombone, he was a pianist, pianist in the band. I can't remember the name of the first trombone.
Did he record with you? No.
